messages:
clara: heads-up — customer canary failed when their service called rerank after we turned on the new batching helper in sampleapp
clara: server error snippet:
```
Error: dot product dimension mismatch: 1280 vs 640
at rerank_handler.py:213
```
omar: which sdks/languages are involved?
clara: mix of go-worker (sdk 1.1.0 with batching-helper enabled) and python-svc (sdk 0.6.x). go produced 1280 because pad_to_max=true there, python produced 640. they called rerank with mixed candidate_embeddings
lia: also saw auth refresh churn in logs — some requests retried after a 401 and ended up duplicating earlier shorter vectors alongside the new padded ones
sdk-patchbot: created issue REDX-embed-1200: "embedding_dim in responses + pad parity" assigned to @omar
omar: quick patch: sampleapp hotfix that asserts uniform embedding length before calling rerank and returns a friendly client error pointing to SDK pad_to_max mismatch. I'll link PR after I push
ops-ivy: please also add idempotency to batch calls. retries during token refresh should not produce duplicate items with different padding states
clara: minimal failing payload I collected (sanitized):
```
POST /v1/rerank
{
  "query_embedding": [0.001, ...]  # len=1280
  "candidate_embeddings": [ [0.002,...] # len=640, [0.003,...] # len=1280 ]
}
```
omar: short-term: hotfix + support note. long-term proposals:
- server should include "embedding_dim" metadata on every embedding response (single + batch)
- rerank should validate uniform dims server-side and return structured error {"code":"EMB_DIM_MISMATCH","message":"...","hint":"check sdk.pad_to_max / model version"}
- standardize pad_to_max default across SDKs (prefer false)
- add idempotency header to batch endpoints
lia: UX thing: onboarding/sampleapp should print embedding_dim right after create so users spot model changes immediately rather than during rerank failures
omar: agreed. I'll take SDK parity PRs (go, py, node) to expose embedding_dim and align pad_to_max. will add integration test mixing clients to CI
clara: PR opened for sampleapp hotfix: github.com/redwood/sampleapp/pull/845 — includes assert + clearer error & idempotency header. CI passed locally
sdk-patchbot: sampleapp PR #845 CI: passed :white_check_mark:
ops-ivy: rolling hotfix to canary now. customer notified.
clara: customer confirmed canary stabilized after hotfix, will follow-up with postmortem + runbook steps for on-call (check embedding_dim when rerank errors occur)
omar: I'll draft server-side change to attach embedding_dim to batch responses and rerank validation. linking follow-ups to REDX-embed-1200
lia: also adding a short onboarding blurb that shows how to call the metadata endpoint to confirm model dims, and printing dims in sampleapp logs: "embedding created (dim=640)"
clara: thanks team. closing loop for now — will monitor for 48h and escalate if we see any auth-retry dupes again :pray:
